notes.subject: ⟨hu⟩
notes.rationale: Maltese needs a copula; the Hebrew is pure juxtaposition — 'my strength and my song is Jah'.

notes.subject: וזמרת
notes.rationale: זמרת here is 'song/praise' (also Exod 15:2, Isa 12:2), but the root זמר can mean 'to prune'; some read 'my protection' from a cognate — 'song' vs 'protection'.

notes.subject: ħelsien
notes.rationale: ישועה is 'deliverance/victory/salvation'; 'ħelsien' (deliverance, being set free) keeps the concrete sense without later doctrinal loading.

translation: Qawwa u għana ⟨hu⟩ Jaħ, u sar lili għal-ħelsien.
